D005-D006_h001.question_both: It's been a rough couple of months, ever since early June, I guess. I'm a logistics coordinator, so I usually thrive on order, but it feels like my own mind is anything but orderly lately. There's this woman, Sarah, from our client's office. I've become convinced she's madly in love with me. The way she looks at me, the little smiles… it’s all just confirmation. I know it sounds strange, but I *feel* it. And the voices don’t help. They started around the same time. Sometimes they’re whispering my name, sometimes it's like a soft murmur, or even full conversations that aren't there. It makes it hard to focus, to get tasks done at work, and honestly, just to sleep. I find myself pacing around my apartment at night, brimming with energy, planning out all these grand gestures for Sarah, feeling like I could conquer anything. But then the voices chime in, and I just feel… off. It's exhausting.
D005-D006_h001.question_a:
It's been about two months now, and things just feel… off. Like, I know for a fact this woman at work, Sarah, she's totally into me. The way she looks at me, the little smiles… it’s more than just being friendly, you know? She's clearly smitten, even if she tries to hide it. I also keep hearing voices, mostly when I'm alone. They’re not always clear, sometimes just muttering, but other times it’s like a full-on conversation about me, commenting on what I’m doing. This all started around two months ago.

Before that, maybe a couple of weeks into it, I had a period where I felt absolutely fantastic, on top of the world, barely sleeping but still buzzing with energy and ideas for optimizing our whole logistics setup. That felt good, but it didn't last too long. Now, that intense high has gone, but these other things, the voices and knowing about Sarah, they’re still very much here, every single day.
D005-D006_h001.question_b:
Lately, things have been really tough, doc. It’s like my mind is playing tricks on me. For about two months now, I’ve been hearing voices. They aren't constant, but they pop up, sometimes whispering, sometimes a bit louder, and it's always unsettling, even when they're not saying anything specific. I also have this feeling, a strong one, that my boss, Sarah, is in love with me. I know it sounds strange, but I see the way she looks at me, the way she asks about my weekend – it all points to her having strong feelings. I know other people might not see it, but I’m convinced.

What's really getting to me is how I’ve been feeling on top of all that. I've had these incredible bursts of energy for ages now, practically since this whole thing started. I barely sleep, maybe two or three hours a night, yet I feel totally wired, full of ideas, and I talk so fast I can barely keep up with my own thoughts. I’ve been spending like crazy too, just buying things impulsively. This elevated mood has been present for most of the time I’ve been struggling with these voices and beliefs about Sarah. But here's the thing, there was this period, maybe a couple of weeks, where I was still hearing voices and convinced about Sarah, but I wasn't feeling all hyper and grandiose like I usually do. My mood was pretty flat then, but the other stuff was still there. It’s hard to manage my logistics job when my mind is racing and I'm convinced of these things.

I also feel this incredible surge of energy sometimes, like I could work for days without sleep, my mind racing with new ideas for the factory floor. I’ve had a few stretches where I felt incredibly energetic, like I could work for days without sleep, and my mind was racing with brilliant ideas for improving factory efficiency. It’s been about three months now, maybe a bit more, since things took a strange turn. My hands, the ones that used to craft delicate pieces, now feel… wrong. I’m positive there’s something unsettling happening inside them, like nerves are twisting or something is crawling right beneath my skin. It’s hard to explain, but it’s a constant, irritating sensation. Sometimes it feels like tiny insects are skittering across my arms, even when I see nothing there. My husband, bless his heart, tries to reassure me, but he doesn't understand.

Lately, though, it’s not just the crawling. There are days when I just can't bring myself to speak. The words are there, I think, but they just get stuck. My mind feels too busy, jumping from one idea to the next about new jewelry designs or how to rearrange the shop, almost too fast to keep up. I’ve been staying up for days, planning grand expansions, convinced I'm on the verge of a brilliant breakthrough, but then I'll just go blank, utterly silent, for hours. It’s a bit much for everyone.
D005-D006_h025.question_a:
It all started about three months ago. I began to feel this unsettling sensation, like bugs crawling under my skin, especially when I’m alone in the shop. I keep checking, but there's nothing there. It's driving me crazy. On top of that, I’m absolutely convinced that my heart is starting to rot inside my chest. I know it sounds absurd, but I can feel it, the decay.

Around the same time, I had a burst of energy, felt on top of the world, like I could redesign my entire fall collection overnight. My husband, John, said I was talking a mile a minute, staying up all hours working. That lasted for a few weeks, tops. But then, as quickly as it started, that manic feeling faded. Now, most days, it feels like all the words are stuck. I try to answer him or my customers, but nothing comes out. I just can’t seem to speak. The crawling and the feeling in my chest, though, those haven't left. They're constant, even now that I don’t have all that energy anymore. It’s like the "high" was just a brief interruption to this nightmare.

I can feel things crawling under my skin, too, like tiny insects, even when there’s nothing there. Sometimes it gets so bad I just can't speak, the words get stuck, and I just freeze up. It's been a whirlwind, honestly. Most of the time during these past few months, I've been on top of the world, full of energy, making grand plans for the shop, barely sleeping. But there have also been these stretches, about two weeks now, where the crawling sensations and the feeling of my organs decaying are still there, just as vivid, but I don't have that buzzing energy or feel the urge to revamp my entire jewelry collection. My husband, bless his heart, doesn’t know what to do."
